_why: ABSORB ELEMENTS smoke test (2026-11-08). Swaps the Cadre Force-Weaver's slot 4 from Jump to Absorb Elements, same mechanism grease_spell_cast.json uses. Arms it, forces the lacedon's attack type to fire via combat_enemy_dmg_type_override (a dev-only override field, zeroed the instant it is read), forces the attack roll high so it actually hits, then watches whether the triggering damage got halved and whether the next melee swing picks up the stored 1d6 fire rider.
label: dev_scene_select

stats.wizard_spell_4_desc: Absorb Elements—a reflex ward held coiled and ready, waiting for acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder to come at you, so you can turn its own energy aside and carry a share of it into your next blow.
